changes: 🔧 CRITICAL FIX: a product with no explicit inventory link, but with a leftover stock number from before the current linking system existed, never auto-matched to a same-named Inventory Item — its stock badge stayed frozen forever and selling it never touched real inventory. Now correctly auto-links whenever there's no explicit link, same as a brand-new product.

🔧 CRITICAL FIX: when a Void/Refund was charged to "the owner's own cash" instead of the cashier's balance, the cashier's own Cash Drawer / POS Sales / Cash Remittance never excluded that sale — she still looked like she was holding cash that was actually given back, showing a false "Short" for no real reason. Now correctly excluded in all three screens, whichever side the void/refund was charged to.

🔧 CRITICAL FIX: Void/Refund's order lookup only blocked a SECOND request while the first was still pending — once a request was approved, the same order number could be looked up and voided/refunded again. Now blocked with "Order #X has already been voided/refunded."
🧮 Calculator redesigned to match the Owner/Manager Dashboard exactly — a small draggable icon (bottom-right) that opens a draggable panel, instead of the previous fixed floating box.

🔧 CRITICAL FIX: Cash Drawer / "Cash in Drawer (expected)" never subtracted a Void or Refund that was charged to the cashier's own pending balance — the original sale's cash stayed counted forever with no offsetting deduction, overstating the drawer by the voided amount (and risking a false "Over" that then had to be handed over as if it were real). Now correctly subtracted in all three places (My Activity Today, Fund Transfer's balance check, and Cash Remittance), with a "less voids/refunds" note shown when it applies.

🔧 CRITICAL FIX: the Cash Remittance (Logout) screen's "Cash in Drawer (expected)" and Over/Short calculation never accounted for confirmed "Received Fund" payments — a cashier who legitimately received money from the Owner/Manager mid-shift would see the wrong expected total and could show as Short/Over by exactly that amount for no reason. Now included, with a small "incl. received funds" note shown when it applies — matches the same fix already applied to "My Activity Today".

🧮 Calculator is now a floating panel (bottom-right corner) instead of a full-screen popup — it can stay open and stay clickable at the same time as another screen like "My Activity Today", instead of covering it up.

🔧 CRITICAL FIX: a Void/Refund's automatic cash adjustment could get mistaken for "the last remittance" when computing Cash Drawer / POS Sales-since-remit (in the Remit-Logout screen, "My Activity Today", and the carried-over float lookup) — this silently dropped real sales and the carried-over float made before the void from all three, understating Cash Drawer and risking a false "Short" on the next remit. Now correctly skips past Void/Refund adjustment rows to find the real last remit.
💰 "My Activity Today" now shows "incl. ₱X left by [name]" under Cash Drawer when it includes a carried-over float — so it's clear the total isn't just today's own sales.

🔧 Fixed: a Void/Refund's cash adjustment showed up in "My Activity Today" as a confusing "Remittance... SHORT" entry — it now shows clearly as its own "Void: Order #X" / "Refund: Order #X" line instead of being mistaken for an actual cashier remittance.

🔧 CRITICAL FIX: a carried-over drawer float could get silently masked to ₱0 by ANY newer cash_remittances entry — a Fund Transfer, Cash Advance, Send Cash, or a Received Fund confirmation — since the float lookup only checked the single most recent row regardless of type. Now only looks at real end-of-shift remittances, so a leftover float from the previous cashier always survives until it's actually remitted.

🔧 Fixed: "My Activity Today" and Fund Transfer could show a stale (sometimes missing) carried-over drawer float on a device left open for a long time — the figure now refreshes live the moment you actually open either screen, instead of only updating on a 20-second background timer that could stall.

💰 New "Funds" button in the POS (owner-toggled in Settings: "Let cashiers receive fund transfers") — shows cash sent to the cashier by the manager or owner, with a "Did you get the funds?" confirmation. Once confirmed, the amount is added to their Cash Drawer and shows up in "My Activity Today".

🔧 CRITICAL FIX: the Cash Remit "Cash on Hand" field had no validation against a negative amount — a mistyped minus sign produced a nonsensical negative cash count that showed up as a confusing false "Short" to the manager/owner, with no way to tell it was a bad entry. Now blocked with a clear message before it can be submitted.
🧾 "My Activity Today" now shows the actual items sold under each sale entry (e.g. "Stick Rice ×2, Kalabasa") — not just the total amount and payment method.

🖨️ New "Allow Bluetooth Access" button in Printer Setup (Android) — taps the phone's Bluetooth permission directly from the app, for when a paired thermal printer doesn't show up in the device list because the app was never granted Bluetooth access.

💸 "Fund Transfer to Manager" now checks the cashier's actual Cash Drawer balance first — the modal shows how much is available, and the transfer is blocked (with a clear message) if the amount typed is more than what's really in the drawer, instead of letting the drawer go negative.

🔧 CRITICAL FIX: a peso Amount discount applied to a weight-sold (per-kilo) item was being multiplied by the kilo count instead of applying once to that item — e.g. a ₱5 discount on 15kg of rice took off ₱75.00 instead of ₱5.00. Now applies as a flat amount per weight-sold line, same as the discount already worked correctly for counted items.
💳 "My Activity Today" now shows which bank/e-wallet (or Split breakdown) each E-Pay sale actually used, right under the sale amount — instead of just showing the total with no payment detail.

💳 "Split" payment (Cash + E-Pay, or now two DIFFERENT E-Pay methods) is now available on ALL business types — the 11 store types that only had basic Cash/Card/GCash buttons (Bakery, Barbershop, Buffet, Carinderya, Coffee Shop, Fast Food, Lechon, Milk Tea, Pizza/Pasta, Seafood, Snack Bar) now have the full E-Pay system: real QR codes from your configured payment methods, photo proof of payment, and the new E-Pay + E-Pay split option.
💳 New: "Split" payment can now be between two DIFFERENT E-Pay methods (e.g. half GCash, half a different bank/e-wallet) instead of only Cash + one E-Pay method — new toggle in the Split screen.

💳 Owner's My Wallet "By Payment Method" now shows the pairing for a dual-E-Pay split (e.g. under GCash: "GCash ₱1000 / GoTyme ₱2000"), and the "Split" label in Transactions/Sales Report now shows which two methods and amounts made up the sale, instead of just the word "Split".

🔧 Fixed: a product's stock badge could show the wrong unit next to a correct number — e.g. a rice sack product linked to a bag-tracked inventory item showed "12 kg" instead of "12 bag". The badge now uses the linked inventory item's actual unit when it's a direct 1-for-1 link.

🔧 CRITICAL FIX: remittance and expense dates were computed using UTC time instead of local (Philippines) time — any remittance or cashier-recorded expense made between 12:00 AM and 7:59 AM was silently saved under YESTERDAY's date instead of today's. Now uses the actual local calendar date.

🔧 CRITICAL FIX: submitting an actual end-of-shift Cash Remittance after doing a Fund Transfer could save the WRONG "POS Sales" figure (and therefore the wrong Over/Short "Difference") straight into the record — the Fund Transfer was mistakenly treated as if it were the last real remit, so any sales made before it were silently excluded from the count the manager sees when confirming the remittance.

🔧 CRITICAL FIX: "My Activity Today" (Total Sales, Cash Drawer, and the whole activity feed) reset to zero the moment the calendar day changed, even if the cashier still had un-remitted cash from before midnight — it now looks back to the last actual remit instead of hard-resetting at midnight, so unremitted cash never silently disappears from the count.

🔧 Fixed: after the previous Fund Transfer → Cash on Hand update, "My Activity Today" started showing the wrong Cash Drawer total (and a confusing duplicate "Remittance" entry) whenever a cashier did a Fund Transfer — sales made before the transfer were being dropped from the expected drawer amount. Fund Transfers no longer count as an end-of-shift remit for this calculation.

💸 "Fund Transfer to Manager" now adds the amount to the manager's Cash on Hand pool (shows as "Cashier Transfer" in Cash Remit, and correctly counted in the owner's "Net Cash with Manager") — previously it only deducted from the cashier's Cash Drawer without the cash landing anywhere

💸 Fixed: "Fund Transfer to Manager" had no visible record for either the manager or the owner — managers now see a "Fund Transfers Received from Cashiers" list on the Cash Remit page; owners no longer see it counted in Other Expenses / Net Profit / Potential Profit (it's an internal cash handoff, not a real business cost)

💼 Fixed: "My Wallet" wasn't picking up manager deposits — it was reading from a new, separate deposit form instead of the store's existing "Deposit to Owner" feature (Cash Remit > Deposit, with photo proof/QR upload). My Wallet now reads from that existing feature directly, so deposits managers already know how to make show up correctly
💼 New "My Wallet" (Owner's Dashboard) — total confirmed cash your managers have deposited to your bank account; click "Confirm Received" on a pending deposit after checking your bank app
📈 Relabeled "Possible Income" to "Potential Revenue" — the figure is price × stock with no cost subtracted, so "Revenue" is the accurate accounting term, not "Income" (which implies profit)

📈 New Inventory stat: potential revenue if all currently-stocked products sold at their listed price, shown right next to "Total Inventory Cost" so you can compare cost vs. potential revenue at a glance
🧮 Owner Dashboard's floating Calculator redesigned — bigger panel and buttons, amber-tinted operator keys for clearer visual distinction, taller "=" and wider "0" like a standard calculator layout

🎟️ Fixed: a peso Amount discount only took off a flat amount no matter the quantity, even on "All Purchases" (the default) — 2 of the same product with a ₱5 discount now correctly takes ₱5 off EACH one (₱10 total) in both discount scopes, same as how % discount already scaled with quantity
🎟️ Removed the redundant "Discount (all items)" fields from the "Add Items" widget — Discount already lives in the main cart; adding items no longer overwrites whatever discount was already set there
🏆 Best Sellers now has Daily / Weekly / Monthly / All-time filters — spot fast-moving products, not just all-time totals

🔧 CRITICAL FIX: on some Android devices, the whole app's internal scrolling (product list, cart, etc.) silently stopped working once content got long enough — older Android WebView versions don't support the "dvh" CSS unit this app relied on for its layout height. Added an older-unit fallback plus a JS-measured height as a safety net

🔧 Fixed: switching Discount to "Specific Items" could push the item checklist off the top of the screen on smaller/tablet screens, making it look like it wasn't there — the panel now repositions itself after it grows
🔧 Fixed: the product list (and cart, on some screens) could stop scrolling once it had enough items — a flexbox quirk clipped anything past what fit on screen instead of letting you scroll down to it
💸 "Fund Transfer to Manager" is now owner-toggled — new "Let cashiers transfer funds to manager" setting (off by default) controls whether the "Transfer" button shows in the POS
📷 New "Require photo proof for Void/Refund requests" setting — turn off to let cashiers submit Void/Refund requests with just a reason, skipping the manager QR-scan photo step

🔧 CRITICAL FIX: with "Allow selling more than available stock" ON, a product already at 0 stock was still completely unclickable — the sale can now go through and stock goes negative, same as intended; it only ever worked before while stock still had some left

🔧 Fixed: the stock number shown on a product's card (e.g. "10 pc") stayed stale after a sale until the cashier switched category or refreshed — it now updates immediately so the cashier always sees the real remaining stock

🎨 POS header icons redesigned — each now has a small label (Scan, Refresh, Calc, Printer, Sales, Expense, Drafts, Void, Chat, Logout) plus bigger rounded corners, deeper shadow, and a lift/glow on hover
💰 Inventory now shows a big "Total Inventory Cost" summary at the top (sum of all items) plus a per-item "Total Cost" column (unit cost × stock) — Owner's Dashboard only, not shown to Managers

🔧 CRITICAL FIX: fast double-tap on "Confirm Order" could post the same sale twice (duplicate order, duplicate stock deduction, duplicate receipt) — the button is now locked while a sale is being saved
📦 New "Allow selling more than available stock" setting — a sale can go through even if it exceeds recorded stock; stock goes negative and self-corrects once new stock is added
📱 "My Activity Today" now also shows an "E-Pay" total (today's non-cash sales) alongside Total Sales and Cash Drawer
📋 Drafts moved to its own icon in the header — the old full-width button above the cart is gone
🔧 Fixed: "Cash Drawer" in "My Activity Today" double-counted sales made before a mid-day remit — now correctly scoped to sales since the last remit
💰 Cash Remittance now shows "Cash in Drawer (expected)" up front, a per-bank/wallet Non-Cash Sales breakdown, and accounts for recorded expenses in the reconciliation math
🔧 CRITICAL FIX: after resuming a session via "Update Now", logging out later could get permanently stuck on the POS screen instead of showing the login form
🧮 New Calculator in the POS header — number pad + big "=" button, also works with a physical keyboard/numpad
🔔 Update notification is now a small bell icon in the corner instead of a big top banner
💰 "My Activity Today" now shows a "Cash Drawer" total (carried-over float + today's cash sales) next to Total Sales
🔒 F5 / Ctrl+R / Ctrl+Shift+R disabled in the POS — a manual refresh can no longer accidentally log the cashier out
🔧 Login-form-flash fix made more robust (CSS injected before the page renders, instead of a JS visibility toggle)
🧾 Removed the persistent "petty cash left" top banner — that notice now only shows inside "My Activity Today"
🎨 Fixed: Add Expense form looked cramped/unstyled — labels and inputs now properly spaced
🔧 Fixed: clicking "Update Now" logged the cashier out — it now silently resumes the same session after updating
🧾 "My Activity Today" now shows a clear notice when a previous shift left petty cash in the drawer, with the cashier's name
📊 "My Activity Today" redesigned — color-coded cards for sales, expenses, and remittances instead of plain text rows
🔧 Fixed: Login/Logout entries in "My Activity Today" showed raw device data instead of a clean label
🎟️ Discount now supports "All Purchases" or "Specific Items Only" scope
💰 Drawer Float on Logout — cashiers can keep part of the counted cash as change fund for the next shift (owner-toggled)
💳 Add Expense from the POS — owner-toggled, recorded under the cashier's name
🔔 Incoming cashier now sees a notice if the previous shift left a drawer float
🔴 Void now restores inventory stock, same as Refund (previously only Refund did)
🎨 Header icons redesigned with distinct colors and hover effect
⚡ Store settings (permissions, tax rate, theme, payment methods) now refresh live in the POS every 20s — no logout required
🧾 Cash Remittance reconciliation math fixed to account for carried-over drawer float
